projects.title: Modular University Websites with Mega Menu
projects.fullTitle: Prestigious University Websites with Mega Menu and Modular Page System
projects.description: Designed a modular, multi-page system with a mega menu for well-established private universities. Every page is built from reusable modules, so the client can keep producing new pages for as long as their content allows, without a rebuild.
projects.challenge: Several universities needed pages that look consistent but can keep growing without a redesign each time.
projects.approach: I broke every page into reusable modules and built a mega menu that holds a deep structure without feeling heavy.

projects.title: Multi-Country Banking Website
projects.fullTitle: Multi-Country Banking Website with Location-Aware Microsites
projects.description: Corporate website for a nationally and internationally recognized bank. It detects the visitor's location and loads the matching country microsite, so overseas customers get locally relevant content.
projects.challenge: One bank, many countries: visitors should land on content that fits where they are, not a generic page.
projects.approach: I designed one core structure with country microsites that load by location, so each market feels local.

projects.title: Defense Legal Services Website
projects.fullTitle: Legal Services Website for Defense-Industry Clients (Australia)
projects.description: Informative website for an Australian legal practice serving the defense industry. Delivered through an international collaboration on a fast timeline.
projects.challenge: A serious practice with a tight international schedule and a specialist audience.
projects.approach: I kept the design calm and direct and agreed decisions fast with the team across time zones.

projects.title: Job Search Platform
projects.fullTitle: Job Search Platform for Employers and Job Seekers (Australia)
projects.description: Australian job platform with informative pages for both employers and job hunters. It has detailed search filters and integrated applications, so finding and applying for a job takes less effort.
projects.challenge: Employers and job seekers want different things from the same platform, and both hate long forms.
projects.approach: I separated the two journeys, put powerful filters up front and folded applying into the same flow as searching.

projects.title: Luxury Fashion Retail Web and Mobile App
projects.fullTitle: Luxury Fashion Retail Website and Mobile App with Private Appointments, Staff Chat, Raffles and Auctions
projects.description: White-glove web and mobile experience for a luxury fashion and collectibles brand. Customers can book private store visits and chat with staff, and staff can escalate to managers and other branches. Full e-commerce with promos, loyalty, reservations, raffles and auctions.
projects.challenge: A luxury customer expects personal service, and the app had to feel as attentive as a boutique visit.
projects.approach: I built private appointments and staff chat first, then escalation to managers and other branches, with shopping, raffles and auctions around them.

projects.title: Entrance Exam Review Center Website
projects.fullTitle: College Entrance Exam Review Center Website
projects.description: Information hub for a review center covering admission details, schedules, fees, classes, subjects, books, top students and campus locations.
projects.challenge: Parents and students come looking for specific facts, and they leave fast if they cannot find them.
projects.approach: I put schedules, fees, classes and locations one tap from the start and gave each its own plain page.

projects.title: Gamified Licensure Review App
projects.fullTitle: Gamified Licensure Review App with Tiers, Leaderboards and Mock Exams
projects.description: Self-paced review app with video classes, short, long and mock quizzes, tiers, badges and leaderboards. A score multiplier rewards passers but decays with each retry. Questions a learner missed earlier are brought back.
projects.challenge: Review apps are easy to abandon, so the app had to give learners a reason to come back.
projects.approach: I added tiers, badges and leaderboards, a score multiplier that decays with retries, and a way to bring back missed questions.

projects.title: Casual Dining Brand Website
projects.fullTitle: Casual Dining Brand Website with Detailed Menu and Store Locator
projects.description: Philippine site for a brand with international counterpart sites. It has a full menu and a branch locator showing schedules, directions, and each branch's dine-in, take-out and pick-up options as icons and text.
projects.challenge: A brand with sister sites abroad still needed a site that feels Filipino and works for people choosing where to eat.
projects.approach: I made the menu easy to browse and gave every branch a clear card with hours, directions and what it offers.

projects.title: Dairy Brand E-commerce Website
projects.fullTitle: Premium Dairy Brand Website with Full E-commerce, Subscriptions and Distributor Portal
projects.description: Website for a rebranded, widely distributed Filipino dairy brand. Full e-commerce with subscriptions, plus a portal for partners and small resellers.
projects.challenge: A rebrand meant a bigger audience, from everyday shoppers to small resellers, all on one site.
projects.approach: I designed a simple shop with subscriptions for regulars and a separate portal for partners and distributors.

projects.title: Nonprofit Giving Website
projects.fullTitle: Nonprofit Child Sponsorship Website with Streamlined Giving Options
projects.description: Nonprofit website that makes giving easier for donors who want to contribute, with clear and simple ways to send help.
projects.challenge: People who want to give should not have to think about how.
projects.approach: I reduced giving to a few clear options and kept everything else out of the way.

projects.title: Pharma Distributor E-commerce Platform
projects.fullTitle: Pharmaceutical Distributor Platform with Rx Subscriptions, Loyalty and Doctor Incentives
projects.description: Web and mobile e-commerce for a pharmaceutical distributor. It supports medicine subscriptions, prescription (Rx) orders, a customer loyalty system and an incentive program for doctors.
projects.challenge: Medicine is ordered by patients and by doctors, and each needs different rules and different trust.
projects.approach: I designed subscriptions and Rx ordering for patients, a loyalty system on top, and an incentive programme for doctors.

projects.title: Wine Brand Website with Personality Quiz
projects.fullTitle: Imported Wine Brand Website with Animated Storytelling and Personality Quiz
projects.description: Highly creative brand website for an imported wine label, with heavy animation and interaction throughout. A personality quiz recommends which wine suits the visitor.
projects.challenge: A wine label wants a visitor to feel something before they ever read about a bottle.
projects.approach: I let animation carry the story and used a short personality quiz to turn the mood into a recommendation.

projects.title: Boutique Hotel Websites Under One Brand
projects.fullTitle: Elegant Boutique Hotel, House and Suite Websites Under One Brand (Germany)
projects.description: Three sister websites for a German hospitality brand, built on one shared structure. The design is elegant and modern, showcasing the hotel, houses and suites.
projects.challenge: Three sister properties needed their own character while staying clearly one brand.
projects.approach: I built one shared structure and let each site change its imagery, palette and tone around it.

projects.title: Boutique Hotel Group Website
projects.fullTitle: Boutique Hotel Group Website with Classic Map-Inspired Design (UK and Germany)
projects.description: Website for a boutique hotel group with properties in the UK and Germany. It has a creative, classic-map visual style and rich assets. Sister brand of a sibling hotel group under the same developer.
projects.challenge: The group spans two countries and needed to feel classic and a little adventurous at once.
projects.approach: I took a map-inspired look, rich with illustration and assets, and supported the lead designer on the build-out.

projects.title: Multi-Mall Website with Interactive Directory
projects.fullTitle: Multi-Mall Retail Website with Cinema Listings and Interactive Mall Directory
projects.description: Informative website for the major malls of a large, multi-brand business group. It has cinema listings and informative pages, a creatively presented loyalty section, and the main feature is the interactive mall directory.
projects.challenge: A mall visitor wants to find a shop or a film in seconds, not scroll through a brochure.
projects.approach: I made the interactive directory the heart of the site and kept cinema listings and loyalty one step away.

projects.title: Industry Association Website
projects.fullTitle: Industry Association Website Connecting a National Tech Sector to Global Markets
projects.description: Informative website for the national IT and business process management association, which represents the sector internationally. Clean, lightly creative design.
projects.challenge: An association speaks to its members and to the world, and both need to feel at home.
projects.approach: I kept the design clean and lightly creative so the sector's story comes first.

projects.title: Nationwide Pawnshop Platform
projects.fullTitle: Nationwide Pawnshop Platform with Online Appraisal and Multi-Branch Management
projects.description: Nationwide pawnshop with online appraisal. The system handles a complex multi-branch structure covering loans, sales and item storage.
projects.challenge: A pawnshop network handles loans, sales and storage across many branches, and customers want a fast online estimate.
projects.approach: I designed online appraisal for customers and a structured multi-branch system for the staff behind it.

projects.title: Author Platform with E-Book Reader
projects.fullTitle: Independent Author Platform with Subscriptions and E-Book Style Reader
projects.description: Platform for an independent Philippine writer with an international readership. Readers subscribe to stories and read in an e-book style reader with adjustable fonts, saved pages, book navigation, comments and replies. Includes accounts with subscriptions and dark mode.
projects.challenge: Readers should feel like they are holding a book, not scrolling a page.
projects.approach: I built an e-book style reader with adjustable fonts, saved pages and book navigation, then added comments, replies and subscriptions.

projects.title: Veterans Pension Assistance Website
projects.fullTitle: Pension Claims Assistance Website for Military Veterans (US)
projects.description: Small informative website for an organization that helps US military veterans collect and claim the pensions they're owed. Templated design made from scratch, built on a modular approach so it can be extended later.
projects.challenge: Veterans are looking for clarity and trust, and the organisation needed something it could grow.
projects.approach: I designed a modular template from scratch so new pages and sections can be added later.

projects.title: On-Demand Courier Apps
projects.fullTitle: On-Demand Courier Apps for Customers and Drivers with Route Tracking and Multi-Point Booking
projects.description: Two mobile apps. Drivers log required inputs such as the odometer reading (for fuel consumption), follow a planned route, collect payments and documents, and take progress photos through each trip stage. Customers book couriers with multiple stops, track them on a map, and choose whether the sender or the receiver pays.
projects.challenge: Drivers have to log a lot during a trip, and customers want to know what is happening at every stop.
projects.approach: I split it into two apps: a driver app guided stage by stage, and a customer app for multi-stop booking and live tracking.

projects.title: Multi-Brand Hotel Group Website
projects.fullTitle: Multi-Brand Hotel and Resort Group Website
projects.description: Website for a multi-brand hospitality group. The brands came from the client, and I redesigned the experience so development follows UI/UX standards consistently across every brand.
projects.challenge: Several brands under one group all needed to feel right but follow the same standards.
projects.approach: I redesigned the experience around a shared UI/UX base so development stays consistent across brands.

projects.title: Elevated Bakery and Dining Website
projects.fullTitle: Elevated Bakery and Dining Brand Website with Loyalty, Pre-Order and Delivery
projects.description: Creative informative website for an upscale bakery and all-day dining brand covering cakes, pastry, and breakfast, lunch and dinner menus. Supports pre-order, delivery and dine-in, with a loyalty program as a core goal.
projects.challenge: An upscale bakery has to look as good as its pastry, and still take orders without friction.
projects.approach: I designed a warm, editorial look, then made pre-order, delivery and dine-in feel like one calm flow with loyalty built in.

projects.title: Creative Brand Website with 3D Hero
projects.fullTitle: Creative Brand Website with 3D-Designed Hero Section
projects.description: Brand website with a 3D hero section. Each object was modeled with deliberate lighting, materials, measurements and motion, then exported as image pieces for front-end developers to implement.
projects.challenge: The hero needed to feel real and tactile, and front-end developers needed pieces they could actually build.
projects.approach: I modeled each object with careful lighting, materials, measurements and motion, then exported image pieces for the build.

projects.title: Editorial Publishing Platform
projects.fullTitle: Media Content Platform with Editorial Review and Scheduling Workflow
projects.description: Publishing portal with an editorial system where writers, photographers, checkers and vetters submit and review content, then draft, publish or schedule it.
projects.challenge: Many people touch one story, from writing to checking to publishing, and nothing can slip through.
projects.approach: I designed the editorial system around each role and a clear path from draft to published or scheduled.

projects.title: Inventory and Order Management System
projects.fullTitle: Nationwide Inventory and Order Management System for a Manufacturer
projects.description: Admin system covering production and stock entry, audits and orders from branches nationwide. It also handles order approval, logistics, sales audits and returns.
projects.challenge: Stock, orders and audits move across branches nationwide, and a mistake in one spot shows up everywhere.
projects.approach: I mapped the flows first, then designed screens for entry, approvals, logistics, audits and returns.
